verdict.rationale: Temporal's own CLI documents batch jobs, which shows a first-party mechanism for operations spanning many items. However, the evidence only describes checking the progress of an existing batch job by ID, not which bulk actions can be run or how items are selected. Missing for 10: documentation of starting bulk actions (e.g., signal, cancel or terminate across many workflows), selecting items by query or filter, UI or API bulk support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Show the progress of an ongoing batch job. Pass a valid job ID to display its information
